levels.surface: أبو بكر محمد بن عمر بن عثمان بن الفضل العقيلي

notes: «بهذا الإسناد» sits inside the chain before «عن مشايخه»: read as a back_reference, its antecedent is not in this report's context
«عن مشايخه» is an unnamed gap («his shaykhs») and is kept in its place; «الفقيه» is a title and is left out
Ibn Umar is the last link; the Prophet is the end
